summary: A date on the calendar decides who starts school this year: some states require the child to be five by a set autumn day.
realLife: State footnotes set local cutoffs, such as five years old before October 15 in one state and five by September 30 in a district.
sources: NCES, compulsory school attendance laws by state (table 5.1, 2017): https://nces.ed.gov/programs/statereform/tab5_1.asp
inGame: needs: an entry cutoff date in the school module, so a start year can be told as the date that made it.
